warnings: Three truss elevations on one sheet, recorded in one section file (each is one element). steel_section is the web/chord section the callout leaders point at; the other printed member sizes on each truss are kept verbatim in other_members_printed_as (the leaders, not a table, give the roles — flagged).

The panel chains print no grid markers; they are in the grid master as floating chains. Supports are read from the post labels (T3 under T2's left end, T3 under T4, T2 under T5) and match the plan positions on S-04.
